content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Biloxi

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree with three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma with five years of equivalent experience. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria and gather documentation of your professional background before enrolling in Granite PM Academy's bootcamp.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP bootcamp designed for working professionals. Our nationwide online format lets you complete the required formal education from Biloxi on your schedule, with active certified practitioners guiding you through the PMBOK® framework and real-world application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your bootcamp hours, complete and submit your official PMI PMP application online, detailing your education and project-management experience. Pay the associated exam fee directly to PMI. Granite PM Academy's team can answer questions about the submission process.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor office hours—to solidify your readiness. When prepared, schedule your exam through PMI's authorized testing partner and take the computer-based test at a proctored center or approved remote location.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, you must renew it every three years by earning professional development units (PDUs) through project work, training, and community involvement. Plan your PDU strategy early to keep your credential active and competitive throughout your career in Biloxi's dynamic job market.
